verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
You are my treasure
My greatest pleasure
Is the knowledge of God
Written on my heart

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
It's the glory of God to hide
It's the glory of God to hide
But it's my glory to search you out

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You are the prize
You are my exceeding great reward

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I will press toward the mark
For the prize of the high calling in Christ
You're my exceeding great reward
